Choosing w nearest c/3 and using C.S_w>=0 yields p_a(C)>=8. The class D=6F+3O+G has square 14 and fiber degree 3; the root-intersection inequality proves nefness, and the standard K3 basepoint-free criterion gives a smooth genus-eight member.
